name: Clockwork Assassin Drone
body:
Clockwork Assassin Drone
CR 2

XP 600
N Tiny construct (clockwork)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 22, touch 18, flat-footed 16 (+4 Dex, +2 Dodge, +4 natural, +2 size)
hp 22 (4d10)
Fort +1, Ref +7, Will +4
DR 5/adamantine; Immune construct traits; Resist cold 10, fire 10
Weaknesses vulnerable to electricity

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., fly 50 ft. (perfect)
Melee sting +10 (1d3+2 plus 1d6 electricity plus poison)

STATISTICS

Str 14, Dex 18, Con —, Int 15, Wis 17, Cha 15
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 16
Feats Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Skill Focus (Survival), Weapon Finesse
Skills Fly +22, Perception +7, Stealth +17, Survival +12
Languages Common
SQ hunter-killer, item installation, swift reactions, winding

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Hunter-Killer (Ex)

Clockwork assassin drones gain a +2 bonus on Stealth and Survival checks. They also can move at full speed without taking a penalty on such checks while tracking.

Poison (Ex)

Sting—injury; save: Fort DC 14; frequency 1/round for 6 rounds; effect: 1d2 Constitution damage; cure: 2 consecutive saves.

Record Vision (Ex)

This is identical to the record audio ability of a clockwork spy (Bestiary 3) except that it records both vision and sound.

ABOUT

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure none

These spindly and discreet mechanical arachnids are ideal for surveillance and reconnaissance missions and can be vital tools in political intrigues or illicit consortium tactics. Their retractable, insectile wings make the swift creatures even craftier foes than most would anticipate.

As they are less combat-oriented than many other clockworks, if a clockwork spy is caught in the act of recording its target, escape is usually the most practical course of action for it. Clockwork spies are about 2 feet wide from leg to leg and weigh less than 40 pounds.

While most clockwork spies are programmed for simple reconnaissance, some are weaponized with built- in armaments to deliver poisons or other lethal payloads to their targets.
